content.short: Sudoswap is a decentralized NFT exchange protocol that enables NFT swaps and liquidity pools.
content.description: Since its May 2022 debut, Sudoswap operates as a decentralized NFT exchange protocol built on Ethereum. It lets users swap NFTs in a trustless environment and facilitates buying, selling, and trading through liquidity pools that participants can supply with tokens. Developers can launch NFT collections on Sudoswap or integrate the protocol into their projects using the Sudoswap AMM. A 0.5% fee applies to trades conducted on the platform.
